_about: Fixes for facts the captions got wrong. Each rule replaces `wrong` with `right` in verified text (guest organisation, role and bio, insight text, clip topic and opening line) of the scoped episodes. A rule applies to a row when its video_id is in scope.video_ids, or its guest_key is scope.guest_key. `fields` (optional) limits a rule to some fields. `guest_keys` maps a guest_key that a correction made obsolete to the one it now belongs to. `guest_organisation` gives every row of a (merged) guest_key one organisation; role_at_episode stays per episode. Applied by pipeline/corrections_lib.py: 06_extract.py (before rows are written), site_stats.py (guest count) and 14_apply_corrections.py (rows already in the database), so a re-run keeps them.

corrections.reason: Caption mishearing: Vaibhav Sisinty's company is GrowthSchool, not Rose School.
Written the way the company writes its name, so his rows show one spelling.
